title.narrative: Technical Assistance to the Ministry of Education and Higher Education

description.narrative:
The overall objective to which this action contributes is to build an education system (Ministry for Education and Higher Education) better equipped and able to deliver quality basic education.

The aim is to participate to ensuring learning continuity under a multiple crisis context through a more resilient education system, able to provide quality, inclusive and safe education for all children per the objectives of the 5-Year general education plan 2021-2025 of the MEHE. This plan is articulated around a main vision and goals, three investment pillars, and priority areas and related program interventions at sub-level of each of the three pillars. This action is expected to make a significant contribution to critical education reforms, policies and strategies that are needed for a more resilient education sector. Through flexible capacity building support to MEHE for improved education sector governance, management and systems, this intervention is expected to be sustained beyond the lifetime of the intervention.
